name: RCE via deserialization on user-controlled JSON blob

input.title: pickle.loads on attacker-controlled BLOB stored in user profile
input.summary: User profile 'preferences' field is base64-encoded pickle loaded by /api/preferences/preview. Attacker uploads crafted pickle that runs os.system on load.
input.root_cause: Insecure deserialization using pickle.loads on user-supplied bytes

rationale:
Classic Python pickle RCE. Reproduced: payload `cos
system
(S'id'
tR.` runs id command on server.
